notes:
A fullscreen story studio. Your photo fills the canvas with a right-side tool column, overlay controls and a quiet Post button. Drag the photo or adjust zoom to frame it. The preview shows the crop that will be posted. Text, full-color stickers, music and filters stay available.

Only real viewers. Story Activity no longer lists anyone who has not viewed the story. No views yet stays empty of names and photos.

Color reactions, everywhere in these tools. Feed hold reactions, the reaction chooser, story reactions and story stickers now use bundled full-color artwork instead of monochrome font fallback.

The three-active-story limit, private access, lock flow, Back safeguard and pastel update sheet are unchanged.
